content:
Deletes the specified user-defined template. You cannot delete a user-defined template if scan
configurations currently use the template. You must delete any scan configuration using the
template prior to deleting the template. You can delete scan configurations with the DELETE
/was/v2/configs/{config_id} endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS_USER_TEMPLATE.MANAGE  custom
role privilege. Additionally, requires the Can Edit [64] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the user-defined template.
